== Biography ==
William Glasgow's origins, including his precise birth date, location, and parentage, are currently unknown. Based on the christening date of his daughter Margaret in 1692, he was likely born before about 1675, perhaps placing his birth somewhere between 1650 and 1672.

He is documented as residing in Hawick, Roxburghshire, Scotland, in early 1692, when his daughter was christened there.

=== Family ===

The name of William's spouse, the mother of Margaret, is not recorded in the available christening record and remains unknown.

Known child:
*  [[Glasgow-2730|Margaret Glasgow (abt.1692-)]], christened 7 February 1692 in Hawick, Roxburghshire, Scotland.<ref name="MargaretChr">"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X11X-46N : 12 February 2020), William Glasgo in entry for Margaret Glasgo, 1692.</ref> (Note the spelling "Glasgo" in the record for both father and daughter).

It is possible William had other children, but further research is needed to identify them.

=== Death ===

William's death date and place are unknown.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3331]] is assessed at 28% (uncertain). William’s c 1670 birth is feasible for John born before 1632, and the inherited placement puts both in the early Scottish/Borders family reconstruction.

An uncertain retained hypothesis. William’s own child’s 1692 baptism identifies William as a father, not John as William’s father.

Next useful test: Find a testament or tenancy naming William as John’s son.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2731 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-2731]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=

*   The estimate for William's birth year is speculative, based solely on being a father in 1692.
*   The spelling "Glasgo" appears in the source record for both William and Margaret. Research should consider variations like Glasgow, Glascoe, etc.
*   Further research is needed to find:
**   William's birth/christening record (potentially in Roxburghshire or surrounding counties).
**   A marriage record for William Glasgow (likely before 1692, potentially in Roxburghshire).
**   Birth/christening records for other potential children in the Hawick area.
**   Records placing William in Hawick or Roxburghshire at other times (e.g., kirk session, land, tax records).
**   A death or burial record for William Glasgow.


* [[Glasgow-1605|William Glasgow (bef.1658-)]] and [[Glasgow-2731|William Glasgow (abt.1670-)]] may represent the same person because;
** [[Glasgow-1605|William Glasgow (bef.1658-)]] is based on the Crowne Shipwreck, 1679, it lists William and John from Cavers (same place as Hawick, near Polwarth, Duns)
** [[Glasgow-2731|William Glasgow (abt.1670-)]] is based on the birth of his daughter [[Glasgow-2730|Margaret Glasgow (abt.1692-)]] in Hawick. 



=== Corrected assessment ===

=== Parentage and identity ===

Margaret's baptism establishes William only as her named father. It supplies no evidence that he was the son of [[Glasgow-3331|John Glasgow]], whose biography independently reports no confirmed children. That attachment should be treated as uncertain pending direct evidence.

No record connects this Hawick father with [[Glasgow-1605|William Glasgow (bef.1658-)]], who is associated with Polwarth and the 1679 Crowne shipwreck/Cavers material. Similar names and broad regional proximity do not establish identity; no merge is supported.
